integrity: The proof uses the published integral reduced Swiatkowski comparison theorem and a reproducible finite exact certificate; the named verifier and data are embedded. No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The calculation treats three unordered particles on the Desargues incidence graph. It determines integral top homology, primitive disjoint-cycle product-torus sublattice, and the subgroup of second homology annihilated by two; neither full lower homology nor full two-primary exponents, cup product, fundamental group, higher particle counts, or homotopy classification are established. Bibliographic priority cannot be certified by finite search.
title: Primitive non-toric third homology of the Desargues graph configuration space
